scope: Data-agent judge and delivery simplification; backend and private accrual catalog untouched.

Answer delivery verifies the receipt without an additional semantic judge call. Clarification review remains separate.
One terminal salvage entry point retains its independent timeout and goes through the same delivery receipt check.
Correction and salvage share output-hygiene validation; removed repeated semantic/style guards after approval.
Removed prose_correction.py and unused delivery-context flags; retained strict evidence and component selection contracts.
Review attempts reports proposal review calls rather than defaulting to zero.
